regions.today: Dry and mostly sunny for the rest of today in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Dry with variable cloud and clear spells at first tonight. Cloud will build from the west overnight, and may bring patchy rain to southern and western parts towards morning. A few mist and fog patches will form also. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 13 degrees in light southerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Some sunny spells on Saturday, but a good deal of cloud overall with occasional showers or longer spells of rain. A few heavy bursts are possible in the afternoon and evening, with a chance of isolated thunderstorms in northern parts later. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees in light to moderate southerly breezes. Coolest near the south coast.
regions.solar_uv: High in any sunshine on Saturday, otherwise low. Moderate to high on Sunday.
